INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the fields and try again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this action.
CONFLICT: This action conflicts with the current state — refresh the page.
PAYMENT_FAILED: The payment could not be created. Please try again.
PLAN_CHANGE_LOCKED: You can switch plans once the current period ends.
PAYMENT_METHOD_MISSING: No card on file — add one first.
NODE_UNAVAILABLE: The node is not responding — try another country.
DEVICE_LIMIT_REACHED: All device slots are in use — disconnect another device first.
SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Extra devices need an active subscription.
EXTRA_DEVICES_LIMIT: You already have the maximum number of devices.
TRIAL_ALREADY_USED: The trial has already been used
TELEGRAM_CODE_INVALID: That code is unknown, already used or expired
TELEGRAM_ALREADY_LINKED: This Telegram account is linked to another subscription
EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: The email could not be sent. Try again later or contact support.
SUBSCRIPTION_LINK_NOT_FOUND: This link no longer works. Get a new one in your account.
TELEGRAM_LAST_SIGN_IN: Telegram is the only way into this account. Add an email first, then unlink.
TELEGRAM_WIDGET_INVALID: Telegram sign-in failed. Please try again.
